notes: All values are the per-100 column as printed on the brand page. Pasta and couscous values are dry/uncooked per the pages. San Remo Wholemeal Spaghetti and Wholemeal Penne have identical panels on the official site (same dough). Helga's serving is '2 slices' with no gram weight printed on the page, so serving_g is null. Kikkoman Less Salt Soy is per 100mL with no serving size given. Macro energy check (P*17 + C*17 + F*37 vs kJ): all within 15% except Kikkoman Less Salt Soy Sauce (calculated 335 kJ vs printed 502 kJ, about 33% low; re-read confirms 502kJ/120kcal, 9.9g protein, 9.8g carbs, 0g fat; likely alcohol from brewing contributes energy not captured by macros; flagged, kept as printed). Weet-Bix (7% low), Helga's (9% low), Corn Thins (6% low), wholemeal pasta (4% low) are slightly low as expected from fibre.
